description: Per-irrep cos / cos_q analysis of Q_β at single wrap. Tests whether the q-deformed cos_q appears at the per-irrep level (χ^λ_q on V_(2,1)) before the Markov trace sum decategorifies it to classical cos. Finding: τ_M-level prediction uses CLASSICAL cos (consistent with AGENTS.md §7b KL decategorification); the per-irrep χ^(2,1)_q values themselves do not match either classical cos((z-1)h/2) or cos_q((z-1)h/2) directly — the cos structure emerges only AFTER the y_λ-weighted sum.
auditOnly: PR #655 follow-up; structural analysis of where the classical-cos resummation arises in the Hecke-character × Wenzl-bridge derivation chain. Supports the `q-beta-cos-resummation` content block.

data.interpretation: Classical cos wins at the τ_M sum level. The y_λ Wenzl-bridge weights are the KL canonical-basis decategorification of the q-deformed Hecke characters; their sum re-classicalizes the angular structure. Cos_q lives at the per-irrep character level (visible in χ^(2,1)_q's explicit q-dependence) but is invisible at the trace level.
